effects: Signing lets a Lombard claimer call mintWithFee and mint the signer's BTC deposit as LBTC, with up to `fee` LBTC (8 decimals) taken from the minted amount as a fee.
The approval is valid only on chain `chainId` and until `expiry`; the contract checks block.timestamp > expiry and fee != 0 (Actions.feeApproval).
The typed message has no nonce and no deposit hash, so nothing in it ties it to one deposit; whether the router lets it be reused for several mints until expiry cannot be checked here.
No token leaves the signer's wallet directly. The fee comes out of LBTC that is being minted to the signer.
formats.shown: "Lombard Network Fee Authorization" with the chain ID shown raw, "Max Network Fee" in LBTC and an expiry date.

findings.title: feeApproval intent does not say the fee is taken from the signer's minted LBTC
findings.evidence: descriptor intent "Lombard Network Fee Authorization"; StakedLBTC.mintWithFee natspec: "Mint LBTC applying a commission to the amount ... @param feePayload Contents of the fee approval signed by the user" (StakedLBTC.sol, mintWithFee).
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Approve fee deducted from LBTC mint" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Allow up to {fee} fee on LBTC mint until {expiry}".

findings.title: feeApproval test signs a 20,000,000 LBTC fee, which is not a realistic value
findings.evidence: cases/0.json message fee 2000000000000000; screen "Max Network Fee" = "20000000 LBTC"; StakedLBTC.decimals() returns 8. The value looks chosen for 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use a realistic fee in 8-decimal units, for example 20000 (0.0002 LBTC), so the test's expected rendering shows a plausible amount.

findings.title: feeApproval does not say the approval has no nonce and is not tied to one deposit
findings.evidence: Actions.sol: keccak256("feeApproval(uint256 chainId,uint256 fee,uint256 expiry)"); BaseLBTC.getFeeDigest hashes only block.chainid, fee, expiry. The message has no nonce or deposit hash.
findings.fix: Change the expiry label to "Valid until" and the fee label to "Max fee per mint", if the AssetRouter confirms that the fee applies per mint.

findings.title: feeApproval domain name comes from storage that the owner can change with changeNameAndSymbol
findings.evidence: BaseLBTC._changeNameAndSymbol sets EIP712Storage._name = name_; descriptor domain name "Lombard Staked Bitcoin" is fixed. The proxy was initialized by an earlier logic contract, so the current stored name cannot be read from source.

findings.title: feeApproval shows the chain ID as a raw number
findings.evidence: descriptor field chainId format "raw"; screen "Chain ID" = "11155111".

couldNotCheck: The AssetRouter that StakedLBTC.mintWithFee and batchMintWithFee call ($.assetRouter.mintWithFee) is not in the directory. It decides how the signed fee is taken from the minted LBTC, where it goes, whether the approval can be reused, and which contract's digest it checks.
